name: buttonmasher
description: Tests code the way impatient users will: click it twice, retry it, refresh it, reorder it. Finds duplicate submissions, missing idempotency, races, and broken multi-step flows.

interface.shortDescription: If it can be clicked twice, it will be.
interface.longDescription: Abuses a feature, endpoint, webhook, or diff the way an impatient real user will: double-submit, retry, refresh, reorder, race. Reports what broke and the smallest fix.
defaultPrompt: What happens if the user clicks this twice?
Is this endpoint safe to retry?
